---
applyTo: "**/*.tsx,**/*.ts,**/*.jsx"
---

# React Instructions

- Functional components only. No class components.
- Hooks stay at the top level only.
- Avoid `any`. Prefer explicit types or `unknown` with narrowing.
- Prefer accessible React Testing Library queries over test IDs.
- Keep components, hooks, and styling aligned with the project's existing React patterns.
- Read `.claude/conventions/react-style.md` for the full guide.
